text:
maria: quick FYI, sandbox shows org key routing into project GPU pool without X-Project header. repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer org_pk_TEST\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"model\":\"gptx-8k\",\"prompt\":\"hi\"}'

josh: wow. paste auth-router trace?

maria: auth-router: route=project_pool id=proj-9 reason=sticky_affinity ttl=300

kevin: legacy sticky affinity binds org->last project for 5m. explains it.

sophia: we need deterministic attribution: header -> impersonation -> sticky. also emit telemetry when route_owner!=meter_owner.

ops-oncall: enable 1:100 sampled traces for 24h in sandbox.

maria: added sample flag authz.trace=sticky-mismatch and filed OBS-8010 assigned to maria, kevin.

deploy-bot: canary: auth-router.sticky_affinity_ttl=0 scheduled for sandbox at 1758010200.

josh: gate via feature-flag so Dedicated stays unchanged.

kevin: plan: canary TTL=0, mismatch telemetry, unit tests for attribution precedence, propose opt-out header X-Routing-Prefer: pool.

sophia: UX: console should show \"effective auth: org_key (sticky->project)\" on request details.

maria: monitoring now, will update after 2h. :thumbsup:
